pli-tv-bi-vb-np12:2.2.11: Following this, the Pali reads _(Dutiya) Pattavagga_, “the (second) subchapter on almsbowls”, to indicate the last chapter of _nissaggiya pācittiya_ rules for the nuns, and then _Pariṇatasikkhāpada_, “the training rule on diverting an offering intended for the Sangha”, to indicate the last rule in the chapter of _nissaggiya pācittiya_ rules. These indications are redundant in the present translation, since I have pointed to all the missing rules, including direct references to their counterparts in the chapter on _nissaggiya pācittiya_ rules for the monks.
